facts.fact: We are Tech reports the World Bank, which already funds Chad's Digital Transformation Support Project, offered to go beyond its e-procurement support to an integrated digital platform for public services (meeting of 24 April 2025).

TCD.note: Digitisation of civil registry records is only a stated government priority in the funded project; no system is procured, piloted or rolled out.
Only a shortage of digital skills is mentioned; no civil-service training.
A stark urban-rural divide is mentioned with no rural and urban figures and no rural access programme.
No programme teaching the public digital skills is stated.
A World Bank-funded project is named (8% disbursed); no national digital strategy is stated.
Digitisation of civil registry records is only a stated priority; no office entering events digitally is stated.
